description:

title: Lone Star Law
description:

A deer poacher is busted, a baby rattlesnake is rescued, a hummingbird evades capture, and a raccoon is released into the wild; the wardens also respond to flooding conditions and a car accident.

description:

description:

Cairn terrier Doogie wants picky house cat to be his friend; Samoyed pups choose between staying squeaky clean with their mother or getting down and dirty with their father.

title: Too Cute!
description:

Dot the English mastiff puppy tries to ditch her sister, Olive, who follows her everywhere; Niles the small Munsterlander wants to be the best hunting dog there is, but he's easily distracted by his mother.

title: Too Cute!
description:
S05 E03 — Chatty Kittens: Pint Sized
Chester the Siamese desperately searches for peace and quiet away from his eight loud siblings; Pippa works at a cat clinic while simultaneously caring for six tiny British Shorthairs.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S01 E02 — Turnin' Texan
Dr. Ross's check-up with a large pet upon his return proves to be more than he can handle; Dr. Lavigne performs an emergency C-section on Frenchie; Dr. Blue plans a night on the town to get Dr. Ross out of his funk.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S01 E03 — The Vet Mobile
Dr. Ross acquires a mobile medical unit for community outreach and Dr. Blue's brother gives it the works; Dr. Ross helps an abscessed iguana; Dr. Lavigne gives a paraplegic dachshund new wheels.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S01 E01 — Hello Houston
Dr. Blue, Dr. Ross and Dr. Lavigne's veterinary venture begins with all hands on deck as they deal with everything from risky surgeries to diagnosing chameleons; a car accident brings everything to a screeching halt when a doctor gets seriously hurt.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S01 E07 — No Goats, No Glory
Dr. Blue and Dr. Ross help a goat farmer at his residence while Dr. Lavigne tries to remove an obstruction within a puppy's intestines; Blue and Ross later have a grill master cook-off.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S04 E01 — Deaf, Blind, and Biting
A family is trying to wrangle their cat, Burberry who is deaf, blind and has recently become violent; a couple is eager to start a family but are hesitant due to the aggressive behavior toward their other animals.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S04 E03 — Penny Hates Puck
Penny is an aggressive feline who has her owners desperate to restore peace in the home; Tony is a cat who displays bizarre and malicious behavior, leaving his care takers puzzled and eager for Jackson's help.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S04 E02 — Roommates From Hell
A woman was forced to move out of her home due to her two cats who aggressively attack each other; a daughter feels threatened by her feral cat and fears that her 95-year-old mother may be her next target.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S11 E12 — Shaken and Very Stirred
A powerful earthquake in the Philippine jungle rattles a thrill-seeking chef and a competitive hockey mom, but the territorial monkeys, rainstorms, lack of food, and dehydration lead to a disastrous face-first fall.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S11 E17 — Honeymoon From Hell
A married couple goes from watching the challenge from their couch in Idaho to taking it on in the perilous Philippine jungle.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S18 E04 — Seventeen Stitches
A wounded adventurer and a cautious newlywed attempt to survive 21 days in the remote Philippine wilderness; tormented by fire ants, stitches and extreme hunger, their ability to endure is pushed to the brink.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S18 E05 — The Serpent's Cove
A military veteran with a crippling fear of snakes and a Canadian cattle rancher try to survive 21 days in the unforgiving Philippine jungle; a mystery visitor torments them nightly; wracked with hunger, they attempt to trap it.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S19 E10 — Alone and Terrified
For the first time ever, two survivalists are forced to spend the first night of their 21-day challenge completely alone in Botswana's, Okavango Delta; raging storms, swarming mosquitoes, and starvation push them both to the brink.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S19 E04 — Predatorland
An unlikely duo, a hairdresser and a former correctional officer, must survive 14 days in Zambia, home to some of Africa's most dangerous wildlife; with predators all around and a herd of aggressive elephants closing in, their survival is threatened.

description:

title: Too Cute!
description:
S05 E09 — Puppy Posse: Pint Sized

title: I Was Prey
description:
S03 E02 — Grisly Encounters
Jordan Carbery is investigating a noise outside his cabin and encounters a massive grizzly bear; Zanele Fox and her husband take a river tour when she is thrown from her raft and ravaged by a crocodile.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S03 E04 — Terror in Paradise
On a family trip to Pattaya, Thailand, Helen Costigan attends an elephant show when one of the massive beasts turns deadly; golf ball recovery specialist Scott Lahodik is diving in a Florida lake when he's attacked by a vicious alligator.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S03 E03 — Backyard Bite
Outside Corpus Christi, Texas, Jeremy Sutcliffe is working in his garden when a rattlesnake bite puts him on the brink of death; while spearfishing in the Bahamas, Kent Bonde is blindsided by a bull shark that tears the calf muscle from his leg.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S01 E07 — Formosan Clouded Leopard
Forrest tracks clues and eyewitness accounts suggesting that the Formosan clouded leopard is still alive after being declared extinct; he treks deep into the jungles of Taiwan where a run-in with a predator might just solve a mystery.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S01 E04 — Florida Black Panther
Forrest combs the Florida Everglades for a predator rumored to exist for years, the Black Panther; it might be a case of mistaken identity, but while scouring the landscape, discoveries suggest that it might be more than a rumor.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S01 E03 — White Wolf of Newfoundland
Forrest teams up with a specialist in Newfoundland in search of a predator that was declared extinct in 1930; the duo meets with a hunter that shot what is believed to be a wolf and uncovers evidence that suggests the species could be alive.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S01 E08 — The Dodo of the North
Forrest travels to the Faroe Islands to look for any trace of the great auk; his passionate search for a large flightless seabird takes him through some of the most scenic and rugged terrain he's ever seen.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S08 E11 — Low Rider
Tumor lowers the chances of a dog finding a forever home; violent dog puts the VRC staff in danger; search is on for stray dog's owner.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:

Tia and her crew race to rescue an abandoned pit bull stranded in an empty house; at Villalobos, Tia's dog Jethro falls dangerously ill while a mother and daughter arrive seeking a new best friend.

description:

The staff becomes concerned when Jupiter, the rescued sea lion, is not himself; the Ocean Voyager exhibit awaits its new residents, black-blotched fantail stingray siblings Bacon and Tomato; Shelley the shy box turtle makes friends.

After eating all his tankmate's food, Tank the hungry sea turtle finds a space to eat in peace; two beluga whales are welcomed to their new home at the aquarium; Scarlett the lovable sea lion turns 2.

description:

The staff becomes concerned when beloved African penguin Zola falls mysteriously ill; the aquarium witnesses the annual spawning of an endangered coral species; Maggie the false map turtle has a date with the dentist.

Assembling a Florida Gators-themed tank for alumnus, WWE Superstar, former tag-team champion and one half of the Prime-Time Players, Titus O'Neil, to commemorate the 100th episode.

title: Tanked
description:

Two-time MLB World Series champion Johnny Damon and his wife, expecting a child, want the ATM crew to help reveal the gender of their baby at a party by building two different tanks.

description:

ATM builds a paddle boat-themed aquarium in Los Angeles for Nick Carter of the popular boy band Backstreet Boys.

title: Tanked
description:

ATM builds a large, saltwater aquarium in the man cave of the Texas Rangers' first baseman, Prince Fielder, for his Orlando, Fla., home.

description:

Pete finds inspiration in old tales to build a mesmerizing treehouse, with a curved turret that soars two stories high and a deck to take in the amazing sights, over the stems of a twisty silver maple on the shore of Lake Chelan.

The introduction of non-native species into Australia has had a large impact on native species; ongoing management throughout the country is a daily task; Dan Cabela meets some of the people taking on this challenge.

A look at why some spiders disco dance; a mysterious creature is preying on Europe's sheep; a whole town is engulfed by bubbling foam.

title: The Zoo
description:

At the zoo and the New York Aquarium, bull sea lions Clyde and Tacoma trade places to meet a new set of girlfriends; Sifaka lemurs Gemina and Andri form a new breeding pair to help their species.

description:

The zoo's lone kangaroo is getting a mate, and the staff is hopeful for a new generation; after months of quarantine, it's moving day for a pair of Mang Mountain pit vipers, and African spoonbill chick Sterling shares a special bond with his keeper.
